hyperedges.label: Dawnborn-Ritual-Ashring Convergence
hyperedges.description: The Dawnborn are living anchor-points (Lux Anchor) for the Ritual of Eternal Dawn; the Ashring site is where their energy must be released or redirected; all five endings branch from this nexus

hyperedges.label: Antagonist-Faction-Consent Triad
hyperedges.description: Three antagonist factions each embody a different position on Dawnborn consent: Restorers (theological justification), Reckoning (city-over-individual force), City Council (strategic ignorance); together they define the consent arc's external pressure

hyperedges.label: Knowledge-Tier-Revelation System
hyperedges.description: The four-tier knowledge system gates the campaign's central secret (Lux Anchor / Dawnborn as living ritual containers) behind three independent clue paths, with the Deep Archive's Corven documents as the primary Tier 4 source

hyperedges.label: Guy Sanders Combat-Puzzle-RP Structure Applied Across Sessions
hyperedges.rationale: Guy Sanders scene structure (Combat→Puzzle→RP reveal) is the organizing principle for all five main sessions; each session implements this pattern with different stakes and content

hyperedges.label: Dawnborn-Ritual-Consent Core Campaign Engine
hyperedges.rationale: These five nodes form the campaign's core mechanical-narrative engine: Dawnborn are Lux Anchors for the Ritual; the Inversion Pathway requires willing consent; consent is tracked; and the ending matrix is determined by consent state. No node functions independently of the others

hyperedges.label: Three-Clue Puzzle Chain: Notation Key → Ritual Diagram → Inversion
hyperedges.rationale: These nodes form a campaign-length Three-Clue chain: the Three-Clue Rule governs design; Session 1 notation key enables Tier 2/3 reading; ritual diagram Tier 3 reveals inversion pathway; Corven's Final Letter confirms conditions; Inversion Circle implements it. Each link is designed to have backup paths per the Three-Clue Rule

hyperedges.label: Dawnborn-Ritual-Ashring Convergence
hyperedges.description: The Dawnborn are living anchor-points (Lux Anchor) for the Ritual of Eternal Dawn; the Ashring site is where their energy must be released or redirected; all five endings branch from this nexus

hyperedges.label: Antagonist-Faction-Consent Triad
hyperedges.description: Three antagonist factions each embody a different position on Dawnborn consent: Restorers (theological justification), Reckoning (city-over-individual force), City Council (strategic ignorance); together they define the consent arc's external pressure

hyperedges.label: Knowledge-Tier-Revelation System
hyperedges.description: The four-tier knowledge system gates the campaign's central secret (Lux Anchor / Dawnborn as living ritual containers) behind three independent clue paths, with the Deep Archive's Corven documents as the primary Tier 4 source

hyperedges.label: Guy Sanders Combat-Puzzle-RP Structure Applied Across Sessions
hyperedges.rationale: Guy Sanders scene structure (Combat→Puzzle→RP reveal) is the organizing principle for all five main sessions; each session implements this pattern with different stakes and content

hyperedges.label: Dawnborn-Ritual-Consent Core Campaign Engine
hyperedges.rationale: These five nodes form the campaign's core mechanical-narrative engine: Dawnborn are Lux Anchors for the Ritual; the Inversion Pathway requires willing consent; consent is tracked; and the ending matrix is determined by consent state. No node functions independently of the others

hyperedges.label: Three-Clue Puzzle Chain: Notation Key → Ritual Diagram → Inversion
hyperedges.rationale: These nodes form a campaign-length Three-Clue chain: the Three-Clue Rule governs design; Session 1 notation key enables Tier 2/3 reading; ritual diagram Tier 3 reveals inversion pathway; Corven's Final Letter confirms conditions; Inversion Circle implements it. Each link is designed to have backup paths per the Three-Clue Rule
